request.purpose: Re-run GW003 vs GW007 Match Report schema and trigger diff because shared response was overwritten
request.sql: SELECT 'COLUMN' kind,TABLE_NAME object_name,COLUMN_NAME item,CONCAT(COLUMN_TYPE,'|NULL=',IS_NULLABLE,'|DEFAULT=',COALESCE(CAST(COLUMN_DEFAULT AS CHAR),'NULL'),'|EXTRA=',EXTRA) detail FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME IN ('GW003_IMC Match Report','GW007_IMC Match Report') UNION ALL SELECT 'TRIGGER',EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE,TRIGGER_NAME,CONCAT(ACTION_TIMING,' ',EVENT_MANIPULATION,'|',ACTION_STATEMENT) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND EVENT_OBJECT_TABLE IN ('GW003_IMC Match Report','GW007_IMC Match Report') ORDER BY kind,object_name,item
